shots.focal_element: Recreated 'Members' role-management card (four users with Owner / Super Admin / Member dropdowns) with a cursor, at the centre of a mosaic of coloured feature tiles
shots.typography: UI-scale neutral grotesk sans: bold sentence-case 'Members' header, bold white label on an orange 'Add member' button, medium-weight names over regular smaller emails, regular-weight dropdown labels; normal tracking (font family not identifiable; low-confidence guess: Zapier's brand sans).
shots.what_happens: The camera pulls out from the super-admin Members card to reveal it as one tile in a mosaic of earlier feature cards (editor steps with green checks, checklist, dropdown form, placeholder cards) on peach, orange, mint, lilac and dark tiles; the whole mosaic then shrinks into a rounded-corner frame floating on a navy field, recapping the features under the VO 'and keep your automation coming.' (w330-w334).
shots.build_rebuild: Start zoomed on the Members card, then scale the parent mosaic group (a 3x3 grid of rounded coloured tiles each holding a small card with a hard offset shadow) from ~2.5x down to ~0.5x with an ease-in-out while clipping it to a rounded rectangle over a navy background.

shots.focal_element: Orange rounded panel carrying three icon tiles (bell, stacked-layers, gear) and small rolling dots, replacing the shrunken feature mosaic
shots.what_happens: The shrunken mosaic frame slides off to the left while an orange rounded panel pushes in from the right across the navy field; inside it a bell tile, a layers tile and a gear tile settle into place around small dots and a pill that roll toward centre, as the VO says 'There you have it,' (w335-w338).
shots.build_rebuild: Translate the mosaic rounded rect off-screen left while a same-size orange rounded rect enters from the right (shared ease-in-out, ~0.5 s), then stagger three flat icon tiles (bell, layers, gear) into positions around centre with a small dot and pill sliding inward.

shots.focal_element: Small dot cluster at the centre of the orange panel that the camera zooms into, ending on an outlined 'endless' word on peach
shots.typography: Very large lowercase heavy grotesk 'endless' rendered as a thin dark outline (no fill), tight tracking, centred.
shots.what_happens: The camera pushes into the orange panel; the icon tiles drift outward past the frame edges while the coloured dots converge to a single lilac dot at centre, which the zoom passes through to reveal a peach field with the word 'endless' in outline, under the VO 'a suite of new features' (w339-w343).
shots.build_rebuild: Scale the orange panel group from 1x to ~3x around its centre while the icon tiles parallax outward and the dots merge into one, then cut on the dot to a peach full-bleed frame showing an outlined (stroke-only) 'endless' word.

shots.focal_element: The word 'endless' filling in from outline to solid, letter by letter
shots.typography: Large lowercase heavy/black-weight grotesk, tight tracking, centred on peach; letters switch from thin outline to solid dark fill left to right.
shots.what_happens: On a full-bleed peach frame the outlined 'endless' fills solid from left to right (keyframe shows 'endl' solid and 'ess' still outlined; the sheet frame shows it fully solid), landing on the VO 'with endless' (w344-w345).
shots.build_rebuild: Render 'endless' twice (stroke-only and solid fill) stacked exactly, and reveal the solid copy per letter from left to right with a ~30 ms stagger so the word fills in over ~0.4 s.

shots.focal_element: The phrase 'endless possibilities', first as giant cropped white 'possibilities' on orange, then resolved as a two-tone centred lockup on navy
shots.typography: Bold lowercase grotesk, tight tracking: first an oversized cropped white 'possibilities' under a cropped dark 'endless' on orange, then a small centred lockup with 'endless' in light/white and 'possibilities' in peach on navy.
shots.what_happens: Cut to an extreme close crop of white 'possibilities' (with the tail of black 'endless' above) on orange, which pulls back hard to a centred two-tone 'endless possibilities' line on navy, timed to 'possibilities' (w346); at the end a peach block slides up from the lower-left and small orange and lilac dots pop in, starting the next wipe.
shots.build_rebuild: Start the two-line type lockup scaled ~6x and offset so only 'sibilitie' fills the frame, scale it down to 1x on a fast ease-out (~0.4 s) while the background swaps from orange to navy and the words recolour, then slide a peach rectangle up from the bottom-left with two small accent dots popping in.

shots.shot_type_other: kinetic type ('work for you') that hands off to 2D character animation of a cartoon woman inside an iris circle, surrounded by accumulating geometric shapes
shots.focal_element: Kinetic words 'work for you', then a stylised cartoon woman's face whose expression shifts from surprised to happy to strained as coloured shapes pile up around her
shots.typography: Bold lowercase grotesk, tight tracking; words first scattered at different heights on peach, then aligned on one baseline, then enlarged and cropped on lilac with 'you' recoloured orange.
shots.what_happens: Peach and navy blocks wipe across to a peach field where 'work', 'for', 'you' sit staggered and snap into one line (VO 'to make automation work for you.', w347-w352), then cut/scale to a cropped 'ork for yo' on lilac with orange 'you' and four coloured pills bouncing above it; an iris circle opens on a 2D cartoon woman with a green rectangle over her cheek, and as 'Build confidently,' (w353-w354) plays, translucent circles, triangles and rectangles pop in around her while her expression goes from surprised to grinning to straining. Why the character appears here, and what her strain signifies, is not clear from the frames.
shots.build_rebuild: Wipe in a peach field with two overlapping rectangles, place the three words on staggered y-offsets and tween them onto one baseline, scale the line up 2x on a lilac background with 'you' recoloured orange, then open a circular mask on a flat-vector character illustration and pop 10-15 translucent outlined geometric shapes in around her on a ~80 ms stagger while swapping her expression sprites.
